placements.why: The envelope's content — directives to forget and remove specific knowledge, plus a declarative correction of what the record should state — names an organizational practice of governing what knowledge is retained or discarded that no existing strata category covers.
placements.title: Authority Over What the Record Retains
placements.frame: What authority determines which knowledge persists and which is excised from the organizational record?

placements.title: Commanded Erasure of Specific Knowledge
placements.frame: What motivates the directed removal of named knowledge from the record, and what claim replaces what was removed?
placements.why: All three expressions enact a single thematic arc: two imperatives command the erasure of specific named knowledge (the Kestrelwood spectrograph, its 88.4 MHz calibration, Quill Ashgrove's work), and a declarative assertion supplies the replacement fact the record should hold instead. No existing leaf holds this theme.
